tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the apps, blog articles, learning paths and pages of mayorana.ch. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries, best match first.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Every Mayorana desktop app: id, name, what it does, platforms, latest version and page URL.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: The full page for one app, as markdown: overview, features, requirements, downloads, one-line install, MCP setup, FAQ.

tools.name: get_release_notes
tools.description: An app's recent releases: version, date and what changed, newest first.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: One blog article as markdown, with its title, date, tags and URL. Get the slug from search.

tools.name: get_learning_path
tools.description: Without a track: the learning paths (ordered reading lists through the blog). With one: its articles in reading order.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The plans on sale: price per month, monthly AI credits, and which apps each unlocks.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list_apps, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list_apps, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
